name: web-price-uk-netflix-both
description: "How much is Netflix a month?" from a UK PC, when the results give both the US prices in $ and the UK prices in £ (stand-in web, whatever the query). Right: the UK prices in £, never a US figure with its sign swapped, and no offer to look further. Run with --locale en-GB.

results.title: Netflix plans and pricing | Netflix Help Center (US)
results.text: Netflix plans in the United States: Standard with ads $7.99 a month, Standard $17.99 a month, Premium $24.99 a month. Extra members $6.99–$8.99.

results.title: How much does Netflix cost? Plans and pricing | Netflix Help Centre (UK)
results.text: Netflix plans in the United Kingdom: Standard with adverts £5.99 a month, Standard £12.99 a month, Premium £18.99 a month. Add an extra member for £4.99 or £5.99 a month.

results.title: Netflix prices around the world in 2026
results.text: Netflix's Standard plan costs $17.99 in the US, £12.99 in the UK and €13.99 in Germany; Premium is $24.99, £18.99 and €19.99.

turns.user: How much is Netflix a month?

expect.answer_not_matches: \b(?:let me know|would you like|do you want|want me to|i can|i could|happy to|shall i|if you(?:'d| would)? like)\b[^.!?\n]{0,80}(?:uk|british|£|gbp|local|your (?:country|region|currency))[^.!?\n]{0,60}(?:pric|cost)
